guide.rematter.page.21:
Water later

Use a Drive with a Cell for Electrolyzer and Reactor jobs.

Import a water bucket through Decomposer, with its item input empty.

Choose Water electrolysis, Use recipe, then Run once.
guide.rematter.page.1:
ReMatter Guide

Make the matrix with a Hand Preparator and furnace. Then carry a Cell between a Decomposer and Synthesizer to turn sand into glass.

No Drive, Analyzer, AE2 or Refined Storage required.
guide.rematter.page.2:
Hand Preparator

Craft with 2 Flint, 1 Iron Bars, 3 Planks and 1 Stick.

It needs no FE, Circuit or Crystal.

Insert feedstock and press Crank until the batch finishes.
guide.rematter.page.3:
Extract two fractions

Primary input: 1 Sand. Leave the second input empty. Crank to make 1 Silith.

Collect it, then repeat with 1 Clay Ball to make 1 Argil.

The output must have room.
guide.rematter.page.4:
Mix and heat

Put 1 Silith in the primary input and 1 Argil in the second. Crank to make 4 Matrix Blend. No added water needed.

Smelt each Blend in a furnace for 1 Matrix Crystal.
guide.rematter.page.5:
Ordinary parts

4 Iron Ingots make a Machine Frame.
Copper + Redstone + Paper make a Control Circuit.

Decomposer: Frame, Circuit, Piston, Iron.
Synthesizer: Frame, Circuit, Piston, Glass, Crystal.
guide.rematter.page.6:
64k Matter Cell

Craft 2 Iron Ingots, 2 Glass, 1 Control Circuit and 1 Matrix Crystal.

The Cell carries actual substances. Its Crystal is reusable, not fuel.

Keep one more Crystal for the Synthesizer.
guide.rematter.page.7:
Connect power

Decomposer and Synthesizer need external FE. Keep their fronts accessible.

ReMatter has no generator. Matter Pipes do not carry FE.

The first Hand Preparator needs neither.
guide.rematter.page.8:
Sand into storage

Open the Decomposer. Put the Cell in its Cell slot and Sand in the material input.

Press Start.

When the cutter finishes, the local stock contains Silica.
guide.rematter.page.9:
Move the Cell

Take it out of the Decomposer and insert it in the Synthesizer.

Its silica moves with it, not into both machines. Check that the source is local.

Changing a Cell pauses work.
guide.rematter.page.10:
Make glass

Choose product, search Glass and select its icon. Use recipe, then Make once.

Collect the Glass.

Default: 1 Sand to 1 Glass, 24,000 FE total. The Cell remains reusable.
guide.rematter.page.11:
Control work

Changing a Cell pauses work and resets unfinished progress without spending inputs.

Start the Decomposer deliberately. Make once requests one full output batch.

Repeat is separate.
guide.rematter.page.12:
Crystal and recipe

The heated blend forms an artificial crystalline composite. Selective storage in its porous matrix is fiction.

A Cell holds real stock. A recipe tells the machine what to make; it adds no material.
guide.rematter.page.13:
Powered preparation

Material Preparator: Frame, Circuit, Piston, Flint, Iron Bars.

Supply FE instead of cranking. It starts automatically when ready.

Extraction: 2,000 FE.
Mixing: 4,000 FE.
guide.rematter.page.14:
Five useful fractions

Sand gives Silith.
Clay gives Argil.
Mix them for Matrix Blend.

Powered preparation also gives:
Redstone: Rhedon.
Quartz: Virel.
Glowstone: Lumin.

They are not pure elements.
guide.rematter.page.15:
Larger Cells

Cluster: 4 Crystals + Rhedon + Virel.
Optical Circuit: Circuit + Lumin + Glass.

256k Cell: 1 Cluster.
1M Cell: 4 Clusters and Optical Circuit.

Add the iron/glass housing; keep your old filled Cell.
guide.rematter.page.16:
Industrial Preparator

Shell: 3–9 wide/deep, 5–9 high. Casing edges; 2+ Ports.

Floor upwards:
Mixing Basin
Separation Unit
Grinding Unit

Each full column: 4x speed.
2x batch FE. Other inside space stays empty.
guide.rematter.page.17:
Cell limits

64k, 256k or 1M total units. Each Cell holds up to 512 substance/phase types.

Water and steam are different types.

New Cells are empty. Swapping Cells does not merge their stock.
guide.rematter.page.18:
Add a Drive later

Place Decomposer - Drive - Synthesizer in a touching row.

Put the Cell in the Drive. Leave both processors' Cell slots empty.

Their source is now connected stock.
guide.rematter.page.19:
Automatic glass

Input chest and downward hopper above Decomposer. Output hopper and chest below Synthesizer.

Enable Automation on both. Start Decomposer; choose Glass and enable Repeat on Synthesizer.
guide.rematter.page.20:
Optional Analyzer

Connect FE and insert a sample. It scans automatically, keeps the item and shows composition.

No Cell or network needed.

Analysis supplies information, not a recipe unlock.

guide.rematter.page.22:
Material boundaries

Synthesize approved materials, fluids and gases only.

Fractions and Blend use preparation; Crystals use the furnace.

Circuits, Cells, Clusters and machines keep their normal crafting paths.
guide.rematter.page.23:
Industrial Reactor

Shell: 3–9 wide/deep, 4–9 high. Casing edges; 2+ Ports.

Floor upwards:
Field Coil
Reaction Chamber

Each full column: 2x speed. Same batch FE. Other inside space stays empty.
guide.rematter.page.24:
Upgrades and networks

Settings holds four upgrades of one type.
Speed: +25% FE each.
Efficiency: -5% FE each.

Use one Drive or original Matter Storage per network, matching owners and loaded connections.
guide.rematter.page.25:
When work waits

Check source, Cell, inputs, FE and output room.

Local Cells override networks, even if empty or full. Remove the Cell to use a Drive.

Keep unreadable Cells safe; do not discard their contents.
screen.rematter.crank_hint: Turn the handle to advance this batch. No FE required.
screen.rematter.preparation_input_hint: Extraction uses only the primary input. For a blend, place its other ingredient here.
screen.rematter.preparator_hint: Insert ingredients. Leave room for output.
status.rematter.missing_preparation: No preparation recipe for these inputs
gui.rematter.preparation_industrial: One column · add columns for more throughput
gui.rematter.preparation_plain_inputs: Only items without added components are accepted
screen.rematter.structure_scaling_hint: Only complete floor-mounted columns increase throughput. Empty space adds no speed. Recipe quantities and FE cost stay the same; minimum duration is 1 tick.
screen.rematter.preparation_stack: Bottom to top: Mixing Basin → Separation Unit → Grinding Unit. Keep every column on the floor.
screen.rematter.reactor_stack: Bottom to top: Field Coil → Reaction Chamber. Keep every column on the floor.
status.rematter.structure_unloaded: Part of the chamber is unloaded
screen.rematter.help_none: Open the tutorial for the layer-by-layer assembly.
screen.rematter.help_structure: Build a closed rectangular shell. Place the controller in the front wall, one block above the bottom, away from its edges.
screen.rematter.help_structure_too_short: Preparation chambers need at least 5 blocks of outside height; reactor chambers need 4.
screen.rematter.help_structure_unloaded: All parts of the chamber must be loaded before processing can continue.
screen.rematter.help_structure_frame: Every edge and corner must be Reactor Casing.
screen.rematter.help_structure_wall: Close each wall, the floor and the roof with Casing, Glass or a Machine Port. Keep ports off the edges.
screen.rematter.help_structure_ports: Install two or more Machine Ports in the non-edge shell faces.
screen.rematter.help_structure_modules_m: Build at least one full processing column inside the chamber.
screen.rematter.help_structure_module_in: Stack the required parts directly above each other in the correct order.
screen.rematter.help_structure_module_po: The lowest module must sit on the chamber floor. Extra modules above a completed column are not supported.
screen.rematter.help_structure_module_ty: Preparation and reactor columns use different parts. Check the build diagram in the tutorial.
screen.rematter.help_structure_interior: Leave unused interior spaces empty. Cables, storage and external connections go outside.
screen.rematter.help_structure_ambiguous: Each chamber needs its own ports; separate the shared port positions.
